dialogues.speaker: Levi
dialogues.text: Well, normally I have to climb inside the windmill first, check the machinery for any faults, and see if any dust or grain has gotten stuck.

dialogues.speaker: Levi
dialogues.text: Next, I clean the blades, remove any damaged parts, repair them, and put everything back in place.

dialogues.speaker: Levi
dialogues.text: That's about it for the whole process. If there's major damage to the machinery, I might have to call a mechanic for help.

dialogues.speaker: Levi
dialogues.text: After that... I leap from the top of the windmill and enjoy some proper gliding practice!

dialogues.speaker: Levi
dialogues.text: You seem like... a traveler, right? Have you ever been to Natlan? I've heard the cliffs there are high, and there are tribes skilled in flying!

dialogues.speaker: Levi
dialogues.text: I'm saving up, hoping that one day I can take a ship to Natlan and learn some of their flight techniques.
